lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Partner.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: A couple days ago, I wrapped up another assignment as a Scavenger,

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: and I used the money to customize my bike.
You finally achieved your dream.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Which part of Black Typhoon is different?

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: You of all people should be able to tell.
If you were to change anything, it'd probably be the clutch.
Did you swap it for a dry clutch?

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Ooh Partner.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: I feel like I could kiss you right now.
Swapping in a new clutch is a major modification.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: That it is.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: It's like a wild stallion that's hard to tame,

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: but once you've got it under your control, it can ride like the wind.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: If you let it get the best of you, however, it could end up taking off without you, so I wouldn't recommend it to just anyone.
Sounds fairly difficult to control.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Very much so.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: I suppose the same thing can be said of Nikkes.
How so?

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: All of them have such strong personalities.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: They're like wild stallions.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: But it's that same wildness that gives them their edge.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: When everyone is in sync,

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: they're unstoppable.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: And you do a fantastic job of corralling all those big and bold personalities.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: In fact,

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: this clutch may be perfect for you.
Thanks for the advice.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: The next time I stop by,

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: I'll show you Black Typhoon's new look.
Sounds good.
